guards.what: G1: the pickup enchants a chosen deck Attack with Momentum 5 (PunchDagger.cs:24-33) -- filed as a no-op stub while Momentum was unported
guards.issue: Closed 2026-08-03. The blocker this entry named was exactly right and is gone: the Momentum enchantment is ported (audit/records/enchantment/momentum.json) and the relic's `after_obtained` is the five-line shape this entry predicted. The stale pin that asserted the stub -- test_reward_dispatch_and_relic_stubs.py::test_punch_dagger_g1_still_blocked_on_unported_momentum -- is rewritten into its closure test (test_punch_dagger_enchants_a_deck_attack_now_that_momentum_is_ported), and test_shared_enchantments.py adds the enchant, the Attack-only filter, the second-play payout, the per-combat reset and the card-copy clone. relic/_stub is down to bing_bong and massive_scroll.
guards.maps_to: `PunchDagger.after_obtained` (sts2_rl/relics/punch_dagger.py) is the source's three steps: filter the deck by `MomentumEnchantment.can_enchant` (the list `CardSelectCmd.FromDeckForEnchantment` builds), put it up as a mandatory one-card screen -- `CardSelectorPrefs(EnchantSelectionPrompt, 1)`'s one-count ctor sets MinSelect == MaxSelect == 1 (CardSelectorPrefs.cs:62-66) -- and attach Momentum at `DynamicVar("Momentum", 5m)` (PunchDagger.cs:15-19). No shuffle, unlike Royal Stamp's, so the pickup costs no RNG draw.

guards.what: N1: CardSelectCmd.FromDeckForEnchantment is a PLAYER CHOICE, and it draws no RNG
guards.rationale: Recorded as the contrast with this batch's relic/royal_stamp, whose AfterObtained UnstableShuffles the candidate list on `Rng.Niche` before offering it (RoyalStamp.cs:36) and therefore has an RNG-parity half this relic does not. Punch Dagger passes the deck straight to the selector with no shuffle and no stream named, so PROMPT.md bug class 16's second half (a named RNG stream silently falling back to the shared random) does not apply here -- checked whether the stream is CONSUMED, not merely named, as the class instructs. The sim's own selector (run.select_cards) is the counterpart for the choice itself. NOTE per binding rule 7: CardSelectCmd.cs is not hashed by this record; the claim rests on PunchDagger.cs:26-32 having no shuffle call.
